jobs.description: teamZUKUNFT gGmbHteamZUKUNFT gGmbH is a recognized provider of independent youth welfare services in accordance with §75 SGB VIII and has been supporting children, young people and families in challenging life situations for many years. With a wide range of inpatient and outpatient educational support, equestrian education and therapy, and targeted time-out measures, we respond individually to the needs of our clients. Our portfolio is complemented by experiential education programs for children and young people, such as school trips, day programs for schools, and supervised holiday camps. Innerhalb von Kelvion kommt die Kreativität zum Vorschein, weil den Menschen zugehört wird, ihre Beiträge anerkannt und ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen werden. Unser flexibler Ansatz für die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, stellt die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit der Menschen in den Vordergrund und fördert das Engagement und die Karrieremöglichkeiten. Wir geben engagierten Menschen die Möglichkeit, sich weiterzuentwickeln und ihren eigenen Weg innerhalb des Unternehmens zu gehen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft, indem wir unsere globalen Teams dazu bringen, als „One Kelvion “ zu handeln.KelvionAt Kelvion, our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.Kelvion – Together, We Shape the FutureTasks- You actively support us in operational HR day-to-day tasks by taking on administrative responsibilities, such as processing employment contract documents or creating employment references.- You will be involved in maintaining our time management system.- You will contribute to the digitisation of our personnel files.- As part of our recruiting efforts, you will assist in creating job postings and scheduling interviews.- You will actively participate in HR projects, helping to optimise our existing processes.Qualifications- Student of a business administration or similar degree program, ideally with a focus on HR management- It would be great if you have already gained some experience in HR- A confident handling of Microsoft Office is a matter of course for you- You enjoy working in a team and have a talent for organisation and initiative- You have a very good command of German and EnglishWe offerAt Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

jobs.occupation: Head of IGC Development (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Head of Development for Integrally Geared Compressors (IGCs) you are responsible for developing and improving the design of IGCs based on market requirements. You and your motivated team are part of the energy transition and you are in strong cooperation with other international development teams like Core technology or Product Excellence. The IGC portfolio and development pipeline includes core markets (Air Separation, PTA) as well as driving innovation to position Siemens Energy’s IGC Product Line in emerging markets (CCUS, LDES, decarbonized heat etc.), plus growing in Service and M&U business.How You’ll Make an Impact * Provide technical leadership to the team by coaching engineers, supporting technical decision-making, fostering collaboration, and contributing to complex technical challenges where required* Develop, implement and maintain IGC Core Compressor Design Standards and Rules* Plan, budget and assign team resources according to development projects and requested order support with prioritization. Build a strong, global cooperation with our internal teams, external partners, and customers* Innovate, creatively apply lessons learned (prevention of technical issues) and implement cost-effective solutions (cost-out) based on feedback during the whole lifecycle of our product line* Act as technical authority and provide technical leadership for critical customer applications, complex order execution challenges, and major product issuesWhat You Bring* Completed studies (Bachelor/Master) in Engineering or equivalent* Team management experience, either by leading a direct-reporting functional department or leading project-based engineering teams* Experience with rotating equipment with in-depth knowledge of integrally geared compressor design and market trends* Strong background and experience in IGC Core Compressor design (10+ years)* Virtual collaboration in global teams and the use of lean methods, experience in task management with JIRA preferred* Business-fluent German and English language skillsAbout the TeamOur Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining-the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Lean Expert, you will work with the functions to put improvements into practice. jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) in 4D Printing of Biodegradable Parts by Multi-Ink Binder Jetting 191/2026 (Ingenieur/in - Maschinenbau)
jobs.description: PhD position (m/f/d) in 4D Printing of Biodegradable Parts by Multi-Ink Binder Jetting (MultiMAM-101309938, DC-15)reference number 191/2026 is to be filled from 01.07.2027 or later.Pay grade: E13 TV-L Hours: 1.0 FTE (40 h/week)Contract type: limited to 36 monthsTechnical University Bergakademie Freiberg (TUBAF), Chair of Additive Manufacturing, invites applications for a fully funded PhD position within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network MultiMAM (Multi-Material Additive Manufacturing).About MultiMAM ProjectMultiMAM (project no: 101309938) is a European Doctoral Network dedicated to accelerating the industrial adoption of Multi-Material Additive Manufacturing (MMAM), a key enabling technology for next-generation healthcare, aerospace, automotive, energy, electronics, and multifunctional products. Bringing together leading universities, research institutes, and industrial partners from 10 European countries, MultiMAM addresses critical scientific and technological challenges across the MMAM value chain through 15 pioneering doctoral projects focusing on materials, processes, and sustainability.As a Doctoral Candidate in MultiMAM, you will benefit from world-class scientific training, international collaboration, interdisciplinary supervision, and industry-focused secondments. Working within a highly diverse and interdisciplinary network, you will develop advanced technical expertise, practical research experience, and transferable skills while contributing to innovative solutions for sustainable digital manufacturing. Upon completion, you will be well positioned to become a future leader in MMAM, advanced manufacturing, and industrial innovation.About MultiMAM Doctoral Candidate Project 15 (DC15): Binder Jetting (BJT) is an AM technology that uses liquid binders to join powder particles. This PhD project aims to develop sustainable alternatives to conventional materials by upcycling biobased waste for BJT. A key focus is the integration of multiple functional inks to create components with locally tailored properties, such as embedded electrical wiring, magnetic sensing and responsive behaviour. Furthermore, 4D printing will be explored to enable components to change their properties in response to external stimuli, such as temperature or moisture. The overall goal is to combine sustainable materials, functional integration and circular economy principles to develop adaptive components with self-repairing capabilities and controlled end-of-life disintegration.Research focus and responsibilities:• Implement BJT using upcycled, bio-based materials from renewable resources.• Apply functional inks with electrical, magnetic and responsive properties for externally triggered and fixed-time biocompatible degradation. These inks will be optimized for BJT printing parameters.• Advance BJT through the integration of 2-4 distinct inks and produce printed parts with multiple ink functionalities.• Contribute to project deliverables, scientific publications, dissemination, network-wide events, and collaboration across the MultiMAM doctoral networkProposed Doctoral Supervision Panel:Prof. Henning Zeidler, TUBAF, Germany, Dr. Katja Heise, TUBAF, GermanyProf. Rocco Lupoi, Trinity College Dublin, IrelandIndustrial Secondment (4 months) at C-MARX GmbH, Chemnitz, Germany.Academic Secondment (2 months) at Trinity College Dublin, Ireland.QualificationsApplicants must have:- A two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree in in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a closely related discipline.- Excellent academic achievements and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.- Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.- Interest in interdisciplinary research and international collaboration, and interest in getting science applied in industriesApplicants with experience in one or more of the following topics will be preferred:- Additive manufacturing, mechanical engineering, or machine design.- Process engineering and biobased material knowledge- Knowledge of stimuli-responsive materials.- Experimental work involving mechanical, optical, or chemical setups.- CAD modelling, mechanical design, or design optimisation.- Programming, automation, machine learning or real-time process control.- Thermal management, experimental design, or statistical data analysis.Approval and Enrolment Enrolment for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval by the faculty board. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD degree programme (“Promotionsstudium”) at TUBAF. AssessmentThe assessment of the applicants will be made by the Doctoral Supervision Panel led by Prof. Henning Zeidler. Eligibility Requirements: Applicants must: - not already hold a doctoral degree, and fulfil the requirements for enrolment in TUBAF’s PhD programme. - comply with Marie Curie Mobility Rule: At the recruitment date, applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Germany for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately before recruitmentFor the MultiMAM Doctoral Network project, a total of 15 PhD positions are available within the consortium. Applicants may apply for a maximum of two positions and must clearly indicate their first and second choices in each of the applications.Worrking Conditions, Benefits and Career DevelopmentThe successful candidate will be employed for 36 months as a research scientist within the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network project at TUBAF. Starting date is 1st of July, 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.Working at the Resource University - regionally based and internationally networked. TU Bergakademie Freiberg is the university of resources and at the same time the oldest university of mining sciences in the world. Since its foundation in 1765, teaching and research have been oriented along the entire raw materials value chain. Today, this includes handling of natural raw materials from exploration, extraction, preparation and processing to recycling. The scientific fields represented at the university, which are reflected in the core fields of geo, materials, energy, environment and economics, are interlinked along the entire raw material value chain. The idea of sustainability, which was coined more than 300 years ago by Freiberg's chief miner Hans Carl von Carlowitz, was then as now the guiding principle in education and research. Think globally, act globally. - Access to world-class research infrastructure, six international training events across Europe and dual secondments.- Work at a family-friendly university with flexible working hours and Work in a committed and motivated team- Remuneration according to the Collective Agreement for the Public Service of the German Federal States (TV-L), depending on personal qualifications- Attractive additional benefits, e.g., capital-forming payments (VL), company pension scheme (VBL), health management, further training opportunities, “Job-Ticket”)- Further informationFurther information may be obtained fromProfessor Dr.-Ing. Henning Zeidler,Head of the Chair of Additive Manufacturing:henning.zeidler@imkf.tu-freiberg.de (https://mailto:henning.zeidler@imkf.tu-freiberg.de) , Phone +49 3731 39-3066.You can read more about the Chair of Additive Manufacturing at https://tu-freiberg.de/en/ (https://tu-freiberg.de/en/)  fakult4/imkf/chair-additive-manufacturing (https://tu-freiberg.de/en/fakult4/imkf/chair-additive-manufacturing.) . Your application:with quoting the reference number (191-E/2026) must be submitted no later than 05.02.2027 (23:59 CET) by email to: bewerbungen@tu-freiberg.de (https://mailto:bewerbungen@tu-freiberg.de)or by conventional mail: TU Bergakademie FreibergDezernat Personalangelegenheiten09596 Freiberg, GermanyPlease attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:- A motivation letter (cover letter) describing interest in the position and alignment with the     DC-15 project.- Curriculum Vitae (without photo and without information unrelated to professional qualifications).- Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale.- Documentation of English-language proficiency.- Contact details of two referees.- Relevant publications, portfolio, thesis work, project reports, or other supporting documentation, if available.You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. Severely disabled persons or persons of equal status (m/f/d) will be given preferential consideration if they have the same qualifications, performance, and abilities. Please include proof of this. jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Computertechnik; Künstlicher Intelligenz; Informationswissenschaft; InformationssystemtechnikStellenbeschreibung:As part of the German government's artificial intelligence (AI) strategy, the successful Saxon competence center ScaDS.AI Dresden/Leipzig (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is being expanded into a leading German AI competence center for Big Data and Artificial Intelligence (AI). For TUD Dresden University of Technology, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.At the Center for Interdisciplinary Digital Sciences (CIDS), the Department for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence (ScaDS.AI Dresden) offers, subject to the availability of resources, two project positions funded by the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) asResearch Associate / PostDoc (m/f/x)(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)starting as soon as possible. The positions are fixed-term until January 31, 2029. An extension may be possible subject to the availability of resources. The period of employment is governed by § 2 (2) Fixed Term Research Contracts Act Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz – WissZeitVG). A shorter contract term is possible by arrangement.In the COANDRI cooperation project, an innovative framework is to be developed that enables flexible and vendor-independent integration of a wide variety of robotic systems. At its core are five essential building blocks: First, a unified capability abstraction will be created to ensure universal connectivity of diverse systems. Second, the framework relies on declarative, versioned, and combinable skills organized in an API-like architecture. Third, COANDRI enables self-service authoring based on LLM and VLM reasoning, patented tactile-sensing hardware, and AI-assisted skill capture using smart glasses and a voice agent. Fourth, secure AI inference in a closed control loop based on Tactile Internet and 6G ensures real-time capability. Fifth, semantic modeling as a knowledge graph with long-term memory is implemented to enable adaptive and explainable skill selection. The project aims to validate the framework and the resulting robot skills on three humanoid research platforms and at least two classes of mobile robots under laboratory conditions (TRL 4). Validation covers four scenarios: hospital service tasks, mobile workshop logistics, electronics and battery assembly, and banking services.Professional assignment:Chair of Scalable Software Architectures for Data Analytics (Prof. Dr. Michael Färber)Research areas:Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Knowledge Graphs, and related fields (e.g., Graph Machine Learning)Tasks: - scientific research and development activities in at least one of the above-mentioned research areas- conducting scientific research activities within the COANDRI project- preparation of publications in internationally renowned journals and presentation of research findings at conferencesRequirements: - a university degree (M.Sc., M.Eng., Diploma or equivalent) and, if applicable, PhD degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Intelligent Systems, Data Science, Computational Science, Mathematics, Applied Statistics, Information Science, Information Systems, Information Systems Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, Computational Linguistics, Digital Humanities, Linguistics, or a related field- a strong interest in fundamental research in the above-mentioned fields- strong programming skills, preferably in Python, including experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) and related tools- very good written and spoken English- strong analytical and problem-solving skills- high level of motivation and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team- research experience (publications, theses, projects) in the above-mentioned research areas is a major advantageWe offer:The position comes with access to high-performance computing resources and access to training opportunities within ScaDS.AI.TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.Application:Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents (e.g., cover letter, CV, and other supporting documents), quoting the job reference “ScaDS.AI-COANDRI” by December 8, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/) by sending it as a single pdf file to jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:jobs-scads.ai@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, ScaDS.AI, Prof. Dr. Michael Färber, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. jobs.occupation: Doctoral researcher (m/f/d/x) in geography – Assessing socio-economic impacts of climate extremes (Geograf/in)
jobs.description: Founded in 1409, Leipzig University is one of Germany’s largest universities and a leader in research and medical training. With around 30,000 students and more than 5000 members of staff across 14 faculties, it is at the heart of the vibrant and outward-looking city of Leipzig. Leipzig University offers an innovative and international working environment as well as an exciting range of career opportunities in research, teaching, knowledge and technology transfer, infrastructure and administration.The Institute for Geography at the Faculty of Physics and Earth System Sciences seeks to fill the above position.The PhD position is part of the project “CASCADE – Cascading impacts of climate extremes: new perspectives for interlinking Earth System Sciences in Leipzig” on compound and cascading impacts of climate extremes. CASCADE investigates how floods and droughts affect society and the environment, combining large-scale data analysis with a systems perspective on human–environment interactions.Our knowledge of the impacts of climate extremes is only as good as the data that record them. The PhD project aims to uncover biases in climate impact databases and research and to provide a more comprehensive view of flood and drought impacts at the global scale. To this end, the doctoral researcher will link and harmonise existing databases (e.g. ROUGE, Wikimpacts, EM-DAT) into a common event, impact and spatial framework, and will contribute to developing a multilingual news-based impact dataset that helps to fill gaps in existing sources. Using independent global hazard and exposure data as a reference, the project will analyse where and for which impacts the sources agree, how reported magnitudes differ, and how the likelihood that an event is recorded at all depends on hazard severity, exposure, socioeconomic conditions, language and media presence.The project benefits from close collaboration with the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research (UFZ). The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary team at the interface of geography, climate-risk research and data science.About the position- Salary group 13  TV-L - Fixed term of 3 years, Qualification-related purposes - 75 % of a full-time position, part-time employment possible- Start date: 1 March 2027The role- Linking and harmonisation of text-based and established impact databases (e.g. ROUGE, Wikimpacts, news-based data, EM-DAT) into a common global event, impact and spatial framework- Comparative analysis of where, when and for which impact types the datasets converge or diverge, using global hazard and exposure data as an independent reference- Analysis of the geographical, socioeconomic and linguistic factors that shape the visibility of impacts in different data sources- Development of a combined, bias-aware global view of flood and drought impacts- Contribution to the development and validation of a multilingual news-based impact dataset using natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs)- Publication of results in international peer-reviewed journals, presentation at scientific conferences and open publication of code and dataAbout you- University degree (e.g. master’s) or equivalent in geography, computational social sciences, digital humanities, environmental or earth system sciences, disaster risk research or a closely related field- Experience in data analysis, in particular in combining and harmonising heterogeneous datasets, e.g. demonstrated through the master’s thesis, research projects or work experience- Excellent programming skills (e.g. Python, R)- Experience in the analysis of spatial data, e.g. spatial statistics- Interest in climate-risk, natural-hazard or disaster research, e.g. demonstrated through coursework or the master’s thesis- Very good written and spoken English (at least language proficiency level B2)- Experience with, or demonstrable interest in, natural language processing or large language models preferable, e.g. through coursework or projectsWhat we offer you- a varied role with a high degree of responsibility in the dynamic environment of a major university- Collaboration in a friendly, supportive and motivated team- flexible working hours and mobile working to support work-life balance- Goal-oriented staff development throughout your working life, with opportunities for continuing professional development- a wide range of occupational health management services - Remuneration in line with the collective bargaining agreement of the federal states (TV-L), including an annual special payment and occupational pension scheme- excellent transport links and the option to purchase a discounted public transport ticket, such as the Deutschlandticket as a commuter pass- a wide range of food options in the refectories and cafés operated by Studentenwerk Leipzig.Leipzig University aims to increase the proportion of women in positions of responsibility and therefore expressly invites qualified women to apply. Severely disabled persons – or persons deemed legally equal to them under Book IX of the German Social Code – are encouraged to apply and will be given preference in the case of equal suitability. If you have any questions about accessibility or need assistance with this application process, please contact Leipzig University’s disability officers at: schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de (https://mailto:schwerbehindertenvertretung@uni-leipzig.de) .Have we sparked your interest?Please submit your application addressed to Prof. Dr. Miguel Mahecha, Institute’s Director, by 7 December 2026 (Extension of the Deadline) via our online application portal.Your application should include:Cover letter; CV; copies of degree certificates and transcripts; a research statement (max. 2 pages) outlining how the applicant would approach combining impact datasets and identifying their biases and blind spots; summary or excerpt from your master’s thesis or another writing sample; contact details of two refereesIf you have any questions about the role, please contact Prof. Dr. Mariana Madruga de Brito, Professor, 0341 60252149.
